evals.prompt: Create a workflow diagram showing how an SA injects customer context from the customers/ folder into multiple parallel Claude Code sessions, each mapped to a different skill (analyzing-slack-thread, reviewing-queries, drafting-technical-assessment). Show the flow from customer folder to parallel sessions to output artifacts back into the customer folder.
evals.expected_output: A .drawio file with a multi-step workflow diagram showing customer folder as input, parallel session boxes for each skill, and output artifacts flowing back

assertions.name: valid-drawio-xml
assertions.text: Output file is valid XML with mxGraphModel root element containing mxCell elements

assertions.name: has-root-cells
assertions.text: XML contains the required root cells: id='0' and id='1' with parent='0'

assertions.name: no-double-hyphens-in-comments
assertions.text: No XML comments contain double hyphens (--) which would break XML parsing

assertions.name: unique-cell-ids
assertions.text: All mxCell elements have unique id attributes

assertions.name: has-edges
assertions.text: Diagram contains edge elements (arrows) connecting nodes, not just standalone boxes

assertions.name: file-opened
assertions.text: The .drawio file was opened for preview using the platform-appropriate command

evals.prompt: png: Langfuse and ClickHouse architecture diagram showing the dual-database pattern - Postgres for metadata, ClickHouse for traces/observations. Include the data flow from application SDK through Langfuse server to both databases.
evals.expected_output: A .drawio.png file with embedded XML showing the Langfuse architecture with dual databases and data flow arrows

assertions.name: valid-drawio-xml
assertions.text: The intermediate .drawio file contains valid mxGraphModel XML

assertions.name: exported-to-png
assertions.text: A .drawio.png file was created using the draw.io CLI export with --embed-diagram flag

assertions.name: intermediate-cleaned
assertions.text: The intermediate .drawio file was deleted after successful export

assertions.name: has-database-shapes
assertions.text: Diagram contains cylinder shapes (shape=cylinder3) or similar for the database nodes

assertions.name: shows-dual-databases
assertions.text: Diagram shows at least 2 distinct database nodes (Postgres and ClickHouse)
